steal_governor_atoms.deadband: low < steal <= high means no actuator change
steal_governor_atoms.actuator_semantics: soft scheduler preference rather than CPU offline
steal_governor_atoms.smt_semantics: change sibling CPUs as a core unit
steal_governor_atoms.failure_recovery: restore preferred CPUs to active and stop loop if invariants break
steal_governor_atoms.cooperation: best when participating VMs independently honor the same contention hint
steal_governor_atoms.scope: guest virtualization; FAIR scheduling path in the current series
steal_governor_atoms.telemetry_dependency: policy quality depends on accurate steal-time reporting
steal_governor_atoms.workload_dependency: benefit targets secondary preemption costs; independent CPU work may regress
steal_governor_atoms.numa_limitation: no NUMA splicing in the current simple policy

transfer_principle: Transfer the feedback architecture, not Linux Steal Governor's literal thresholds.

fr_soom_mapping.deadband: hysteresis between fold and unfold thresholds
fr_soom_mapping.restore_on_disable: bounded restoration to declared maximum work set
fr_soom_mapping.cross_guest_cooperation: independent applications can self-throttle without direct coordination

controller_objective.primary: maximize useful forward progress under finite-resource pressure
controller_objective.not_objective: minimize pressure or maximize free RAM by itself
controller_objective.conceptual_form: maximize F - lambda_stall*stall - lambda_semantic*loss - lambda_churn*control_churn - lambda_deadline*deadline_violations

marginal_condition: Fold when the marginal forward-progress gain of another active work unit is smaller than the marginal contention/stall tax; pressure is only a proxy for this unobserved counterfactual.

expected_invariants: hysteresis outprogresses fixed FULL in the frozen synthetic trace
hysteresis causes less control chatter than the single-threshold reference
at least one work unit is retained
no live host control is implied

next_physical_sequence: map pressure/concurrency surface and pressure knee
rare-event injection for stale or false pressure signals
only then consider coupling to FR-SOOM-002J semantic residency actions
nonclaims: Linux Steal Governor thresholds are not copied as memory thresholds
the synthetic pressure scalar is not a host-ready pressure score
the synthetic progress gain is not a real-machine performance claim
memory PSI alone does not prove that folding will improve progress
no process is signaled, killed, migrated, or throttled on a live host
no kernel modification is proposed by this experiment
